name: MCL Two-Anchor Inventory Auction Lifecycle
hypothesis: A DST-aware Europe inventory transfer and a United States opening transfer can form one high-cadence oil state machine when each anchor has exclusive finite ownership: Europe exits before the US handoff and US exits before the 10:30 ET inventory-risk window. Exact range invalidation is the only semantic risk alternative.
signal: exact 578 outcome-blind V33 events; no anchor, range, excursion, verdict, direction, clock, cadence, or event replacement may change

execution.entry: one matched-suffix MCL contract at the frozen next one-minute open
execution.europe_ownership: exit at the first completed one-minute close at or after 08:55 America/New_York
execution.us_ownership: exit at the first completed one-minute close at or after 10:25 America/New_York
execution.next_anchor: unexpected overlap closes the incumbent at the next anchor entry open before replacement
execution.clock_or_contract_reset: close at the last continuous MCL close and never synthesize a reopen

structural_law.acceptance: the crossed pre-anchor MCL high for a long or low for a short
structural_law.failure: the first excursion MCL high for a short or low for a long
structural_law.intrabar_order: structural stop, then MFE/MAE update, then anchor cutoff; adverse gaps fill at the opening price

discovery_and_validation_eligibility.cohorts: up/down, acceptance/failure, Europe/US, and high/low each positive under primary and stress

selection_law: Among discovery-eligible owners maximize stress PnL/DD, then primary PnL/DD, then stress net, then minimize primary DD. Only that owner opens validation and full outcomes.

full_law.cohorts: up/down, acceptance/failure, Europe/US, and high/low each positive under primary and stress

control: selected lifecycle's identical entry and exit clocks with every raw hold inverted; it cannot select or rescue
if_no_discovery_owner: Reject the two-anchor lifecycle before validation; do not sweep anchor clocks, reference windows, verdict delay, stop distance, targets, timeouts, EIA exceptions, or costs.
if_development_passes: Preserve as outcome-exposed development only. Missing July-2023 history, unseen evidence, runtime parity, live signal tape, native transport, margin, preview, allocation, restart, and safety remain mandatory before crown or capital.
